title: must, may, might
topic: Modals of obligation, prohibition and possibility
canDo: Bir şeyin kesin, olası ya da yasak olduğunu ayırt ederek söyleyebilirim.

concept.summary: must güçlü zorunluluk ve güçlü tahmin bildirir; may ve might ihtimal bildirir. En çok karıştırılan çift mustn't ile don't have to: birincisi yasak, ikincisi gereksizlik demektir.

table.example: You must wear a helmet. He must be tired.

examples.en: All passengers must show their tickets.
You mustn't park in front of the gate.
You don't have to finish it today.
She might call us tonight.
He must be at home; his car is outside.

mistakes.wrong: You mustn't come if you are busy.
mistakes.right: You don't have to come if you are busy.
mistakes.why: Gereksizlik mustn't ile değil don't have to ile anlatılır.

mistakes.wrong: She musts wear a uniform.
mistakes.right: She must wear a uniform.

mistakes.wrong: It might to rain.
mistakes.right: It might rain.

exercises.text: Visitors ___ sign in at reception.
You ___ touch the wires — it's dangerous.
It's Saturday, so you ___ get up early.
Take an umbrella; it ___ rain.
You ___ worry, everything is ready.

title: could, be able to, used to
canDo: Eskiden neler yapabildiğimi ve nelere alışkın olduğumu anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: could geçmişteki genel yeteneği anlatır. Tek seferlik bir başarıda could yerine was able to kullanılır. used to ise artık yapmadığımız eski alışkanlıkları anlatır ve yalnızca geçmişte kullanılır.

table.example: I was able to fix it yesterday.
We used to live in Bursa.

examples.en: She could read before school.
After two hours we were able to open the door.
examples.note: Tek seferlik başarı → was/were able to.

examples.en: I used to smoke, but I stopped.
He couldn't come because he was ill.
There used to be a cinema here.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I could finally fix the car.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I was able to fix the car.

mistakes.wrong: I use to smoke.
mistakes.right: I used to smoke.

mistakes.wrong: I used to go there next year.
mistakes.right: I used to go there.

exercises.text: When I was a child, I ___ play the piano.
The room was locked, but we ___ get in through the window.
She ___ have long hair.
I ___ understand a word he said.
There ___ be a market on this street.

concept.summary: İngilizcede olumsuzluk her zamanda aynı işler: not, yardımcı fiilin hemen arkasına gelir. Yardımcı fiil yoksa do getirilir. Bu tek kural bilinince yeni bir zaman için ayrı olumsuz kalıp ezberlemeye gerek kalmaz.

examples.en: He doesn't work here any more.
They aren't listening to me.
examples.note: be zaten yardımcı, not hemen arkasına geldi.

examples.en: I haven't finished the report yet.
We won't be late.
Don't forget to lock the door.

mistakes.wrong: He doesn't works here.
mistakes.right: He doesn't work here.
mistakes.why: -s yardımcı fiile geçti, asıl fiil yalın kalır.

mistakes.wrong: I not have finished.
mistakes.right: I haven't finished.

mistakes.wrong: They don't are listening.
mistakes.right: They aren't listening.

exercises.text: She ___ like spicy food.
We ___ watching the match right now.
I ___ heard from him since May.
They ___ arrive before eight.
___ open the window, please.

title: Past perfect — had done
canDo: Geçmişteki iki olaydan hangisinin önce olduğunu belirtebilirim.

concept.summary: Geçmişte anlatılan bir olaydan daha önce olmuş bir şeyi göstermek için kullanılır. Yani "geçmişin geçmişi"dir: önce olan had + V3, sonra olan past simple olur. Tek bir olay anlatılıyorsa gerekmez.

examples.en: When we arrived, the film had started.
He had never flown before that day.
She had already left when I called.
I couldn't get in because I had lost my key.
They had finished dinner by eight.

mistakes.wrong: When we arrived, the film has started.
mistakes.right: When we arrived, the film had started.

mistakes.wrong: He had went home.
mistakes.right: He had gone home.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I had gone to the cinema.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I went to the cinema.
mistakes.why: Tek bir geçmiş olayda past simple yeter.

exercises.text: By the time I got there, everyone ___ .
She ___ the book before she saw the film.
We ___ never been to Greece before last summer.
He was tired because he ___ all night.
The shop was closed; it ___ at six.

title: İkinci tip koşul — if I had, I would
canDo: Gerçek olmayan durumlar üzerine konuşabilir, hayal kurabilirim.

concept.summary: Gerçekleşmesi mümkün olmayan ya da uzak ihtimalli durumlar için kullanılır. Yapı şaşırtıcıdır: if'li cümlecikte geçmiş zaman biçimi kullanılır ama anlam şimdiye ya da geleceğe bakar. be fiili için resmî dilde her öznede were gelir.

table.example: If I had time, I would help.
If it rains (olabilir) / If it rained (hayali)

examples.en: If I had more money, I would buy a house.
examples.tr: Daha çok param olsa bir ev alırdım.

examples.en: If I were you, I would apologise.
examples.note: Tavsiye için en sık kullanılan kalıp.

examples.en: She would travel more if she had time.
examples.tr: Vakti olsa daha çok seyahat ederdi.
examples.note: Ana cümle önce gelince virgül yok.

examples.en: What would you do if you lost your passport?
If they knew the answer, they would tell us.

mistakes.wrong: If I would have money, I would buy a house.
mistakes.right: If I had money, I would buy a house.

mistakes.wrong: If I was you, I would apologise.
mistakes.right: If I were you, I would apologise.
mistakes.why: Bu kalıpta her öznede were gelir.

mistakes.wrong: If she had time, she will travel more.
mistakes.right: If she had time, she would travel more.
mistakes.why: İkinci tipte sonuç would ile kurulur.

exercises.text: If I ___ rich, I would help more people.
If he studied harder, he ___ better marks.
What ___ you say if she asked you?
If we ___ a car, we could visit them.
I would call her if I ___ her number.

title: will be done, get + V3
topic: Passive with modals; get-passive; postmodifying participle
canDo: Her zamanda edilgen kurabilir, günlük dildeki get'li biçimi kullanabilirim.

concept.summary: Edilgen yapı kip fiillerle de kurulur: kipin ardından be gelir, asıl fiil üçüncü hâlde kalır. Günlük konuşmada be yerine get kullanılır ve olayın beklenmedikliğini vurgular. Üçüncü hâl bir ismi arkadan da niteleyebilir: a car made in Japan.

examples.en: The winners will be announced tomorrow.
This form must be signed by a parent.
examples.tr: Bu form bir veli tarafından imzalanmalı.

examples.en: The laptop can be fixed today.
Her bike got stolen at the station.
I read a novel written by a Turkish author.
examples.tr: Türk bir yazarın yazdığı bir roman okudum.

mistakes.wrong: The results will announced tomorrow.
mistakes.right: The results will be announced tomorrow.
mistakes.why: Kip ile üçüncü hâl arasında be gerekir.

mistakes.wrong: This form must be sign by a parent.
mistakes.right: This form must be signed by a parent.

mistakes.wrong: I read a novel wrote by a Turkish author.
mistakes.right: I read a novel written by a Turkish author.
mistakes.why: Niteleyen biçim üçüncü hâldir, ikinci hâl değil.

exercises.text: The road ___ repaired next month.
Tickets ___ bought online.
My wallet ___ on the bus.
This is a photo ___ in 1975.
The report ___ be finished by Friday.

title: mine, myself, each other
canDo: Sahiplik, kendine dönüklük ve karşılıklılığı ayırt ederek anlatabilirim.

concept.summary: my ismin önüne gelir, mine ise ismin yerini tutar. myself işin öznesiyle nesnesi aynı kişiyse kullanılır. each other iki tarafın birbirine yaptığı işi anlatır; others ise "başkaları, diğerleri" demektir.

examples.en: That seat is mine.
Did you make this cake yourself?
My parents write to each other every week.
examples.tr: Annemle babam her hafta birbirine yazıyor.

examples.en: Some people left early; others stayed.
Those shoes are more comfortable than these ones.

mistakes.wrong: This book is my.
mistakes.right: This book is mine.

mistakes.wrong: She hurt her.
mistakes.right: She hurt herself.
mistakes.why: Özne ile nesne aynı kişiyse dönüşlü zamir gelir.

mistakes.wrong: They help themselves every day.
mistakes.right: They help each other every day.
mistakes.why: Karşılıklı iş each other ile anlatılır.

exercises.text: Is this pen ___ ?
He cut ___ while cooking.
The two brothers look after ___ .
Some like tea, ___ prefer coffee.
Our car is faster than ___ .

title: something interesting, here is
topic: Adjective after -thing pronouns; here is / there is
canDo: Belirsiz bir şeyi niteleyebilir, bir şeyi uzatırken doğal biçimde konuşabilirim.

concept.summary: İngilizcede sıfat ismin önüne gelir ama something, anyone, nothing gibi zamirlerde tam tersi olur: sıfat arkadan gelir. here is / here are ise bir şeyi uzatırken ya da gösterirken kullanılır.

examples.en: I heard something strange last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece tuhaf bir şey duydum.

examples.en: There is nothing interesting on television.
We need someone reliable for this job.
examples.tr: Bu iş için güvenilir birine ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: Here is your change.
Here are the documents you asked for.

mistakes.wrong: I heard strange something.
mistakes.right: I heard something strange.

mistakes.wrong: There is interesting nothing on TV.
mistakes.right: There is nothing interesting on TV.
mistakes.why: Aynı kural nothing için de geçerli.

mistakes.wrong: Here is the documents.
mistakes.right: Here are the documents.

exercises.text: Did you buy ___ ?
There was ___ in the fridge.
I met ___ at the conference.
___ your coffee.
___ the keys you lost.

title: fortunately, much better
canDo: Söylediğim şeye tavrımı katabilir, karşılaştırmayı güçlendirebilirim.

concept.summary: Bazı zarflar cümlenin içeriğine değil, konuşanın o içeriğe bakışına yorum katar: fortunately, apparently, obviously. Genelde cümlenin başında dururlar. Karşılaştırmayı güçlendirmek içinse much, far, a lot ve even kullanılır — very değil.

examples.en: Fortunately, nobody was injured.
Apparently, the shop has closed down.
This route is much faster.
The second book was even better.
Prices are far higher this year.
examples.tr: Fiyatlar bu yıl çok daha yüksek.

mistakes.wrong: This route is very faster.
mistakes.right: This route is much faster.

mistakes.wrong: Fortunately nobody was injured however.
mistakes.right: Fortunately, nobody was injured.

mistakes.wrong: The book was even good.
mistakes.right: The book was even better.

exercises.text: ___ , we found the keys.
This laptop is ___ lighter than mine.
The film was ___ worse than the book.
___ , he never got the letter.
Today is ___ colder than yesterday.

title: not to, for you to, be to
canDo: Bir şeyi yapmamayı söyleyebilir, kimin yapacağını belirtebilirim.

concept.summary: to'lu yapı olumsuzlanırken not, to'dan önce gelir: not to be late. Eylemi yapacak kişi cümlenin öznesinden farklıysa for ile eklenir: for you to decide. be to ise resmî dilde plan ve talimat bildirir.

table.example: It is important for him to rest.
The minister is to visit Ankara.
She told me not to worry.

examples.en: He decided not to accept the offer.
It is difficult for me to say no.
The president is to open the new hospital.
She asked me not to tell anyone.
We waited for the rain to stop.

mistakes.wrong: He decided to not accept the offer.
mistakes.right: He decided not to accept the offer.

mistakes.wrong: It is difficult to me to say no.
mistakes.right: It is difficult for me to say no.
mistakes.why: Eylemi yapan kişi for ile eklenir.

mistakes.wrong: She asked me to not tell anyone.
mistakes.right: She asked me not to tell anyone.

exercises.text: I promised ___ late again.
It is important ___ the children to sleep early.
The team ___ leave on Monday.
He told us ___ the door open.
We are waiting ___ the bus to arrive.

title: what to do, where to go
canDo: Ne yapacağımı bilmediğimi söyleyebilir, seçenekler üzerine konuşabilirim.

concept.summary: know, decide ve wonder gibi fiillerden sonra soru kelimesiyle başlayan bir parça gelebilir. Bu parça ya tam bir cümlecik olur (where she lives) ya da kısaltılıp to alır (where to go). Kısaltma ancak özne ikisinde de aynıysa yapılabilir.

table.example: I don't know what to do.
I don't know what he wants.
I know where to go. (ben giderim)

examples.en: I don't know what to say.
She hasn't decided where to study.
Can you show me how to use this?
I wonder why he left so early.
examples.tr: Neden bu kadar erken gittiğini merak ediyorum.

examples.en: This is where I grew up.

mistakes.wrong: I don't know what I should to do.
mistakes.right: I don't know what to do.

mistakes.wrong: I don't know what does he want.
mistakes.right: I don't know what he wants.

mistakes.wrong: She decided where I to study.
mistakes.right: She decided where to study.

exercises.text: We haven't decided ___ for the holiday.
Do you know ___ the meeting starts?
She showed me ___ the machine.
I wonder ___ he didn't call.
That café is ___ we first met.

concept.summary: Emir ve rica aktarılırken that'li cümlecik kurulmaz; kişi yazılır, ardından to'lu fiil gelir. Olumsuzunda not, to'dan önce durur. Soru aktarılırken ask kullanılır ve iç cümlede soru düzeni bozulur.

formula.right: asked + kişi + soru kelimesi + özne + fiil

table.example: They told him not to move.
He asked me where I lived.

examples.en: The teacher told us to open our books.
She asked me to help her with the boxes.
The guard told them not to take photos.
He asked me where I worked.
She asked if I could drive.

mistakes.wrong: She asked me that I wait.
mistakes.right: She asked me to wait.

mistakes.wrong: He asked me where did I work.
mistakes.right: He asked me where I worked.

mistakes.wrong: The teacher said us to open our books.
mistakes.right: The teacher told us to open our books.

exercises.text: My boss ___ me to finish the report.
They told us ___ in the corridor.
She asked me what time ___ .
He asked ___ I wanted a lift.
The doctor told him ___ more water.

title: İlgi cümleciklerinde ayrıntı
topic: Non-restrictive clauses, omitted pronoun, preposition stranding
canDo: Ek bilgi verebilir, günlük dilde doğal ilgi cümlecikleri kurabilirim.

concept.summary: İlgi cümleciği iki iş görebilir: hangisinden söz ettiğimizi belirlemek ya da bilineni ek bilgiyle genişletmek. İkincisinde virgül kullanılır ve that kullanılamaz. İlgi zamiri nesne konumundaysa düşürülebilir; edat ise günlük dilde cümlenin sonunda kalır.

table.example: The man who called is my uncle.
My uncle, who lives in Bursa, called.
the person I told you about

examples.en: My sister, who works in Berlin, is visiting us.
examples.tr: Berlin'de çalışan kız kardeşim bizi ziyaret ediyor.

examples.en: The book I bought yesterday is excellent.
Who are you waiting for?
This is the colleague I work with.
The hotel, which opened last year, is already full.
examples.tr: Geçen yıl açılan otel şimdiden dolu.

mistakes.wrong: My sister, that works in Berlin, is visiting.
mistakes.right: My sister, who works in Berlin, is visiting.
mistakes.why: Virgüllü ek bilgi cümleciğinde that kullanılmaz.

mistakes.wrong: The book I bought it yesterday is excellent.
mistakes.right: The book I bought yesterday is excellent.

mistakes.wrong: For who are you waiting?
mistakes.right: Who are you waiting for?

exercises.text: My father, ___ is 70, still works.
The film ___ we watched was boring.
That is the man I told you ___ .
Our office, ___ moved last year, is near the station.
Who did you go to the concert ___ ?

title: the man standing there
canDo: İki cümleyi tek cümlede toplayarak daha akıcı yazabilirim.

concept.summary: İki cümleyi birleştirmenin kısa yolu: ilgi zamiri ve yardımcı fiil atılır, geriye -ing'li parça kalır. Bu parça ya bir ismi arkadan niteler (the man standing there) ya da cümle başında zaman ve sebep bildirir (Walking home, I saw…). Her iki durumda da öznenin aynı olması gerekir.

table.example: the woman sitting by the window
Feeling tired, he went to bed.

examples.en: The man standing at the door is my neighbour.
Do you know the girl talking to Ali?
examples.tr: Ali ile konuşan kızı tanıyor musun?

examples.en: Feeling tired, she went to bed early.
Walking through the park, I saw an old friend.
examples.tr: Parkta yürürken eski bir arkadaşımı gördüm.
examples.note: Aynı özne: yürüyen de gören de ben.

examples.en: The train arriving at platform two is delayed.
examples.tr: İki numaralı perona gelen tren rötarlı.

mistakes.wrong: The man is standing at the door is my neighbour.
mistakes.right: The man standing at the door is my neighbour.

mistakes.wrong: Walking through the park, the rain started.
mistakes.right: While I was walking through the park, the rain started.
mistakes.why: Özneler farklıysa kısaltma yapılamaz; yağmur yürümüyor.

mistakes.wrong: Feeling tired, the bed was ready.
mistakes.right: Feeling tired, she went to bed.

exercises.text: The people ___ outside are waiting for tickets.
___ the news, she called her family.
Who is the woman ___ the piano?
___ for hours, they finally reached the village.
The flight ___ from Rome has landed.
